snippet.description:
Between every breath lies a threshold between movement and stillness, the visible and the invisible. It is here that the artist discovers presence, becoming a medium through which Rasa, or Oneness, unfolds. Through the nine fundamental emotions of the Navarasas, brought to life by the timeless figures of the Mahabharata, the film explores Mukharagam—an ancient breathing art, quietly transmitted across generations, holding the subtle power to shape space, channel emotion, and awaken consciousness.

The pause is not an absence, but a universe of possibilities—the silence before speech, the stillness before movement, the emptiness that contains everything. Mukharagam invites us to inhabit this sacred space, rediscovering the vitality of the present moment in a world consumed by speed. Through an ever-unfolding process of catharsis and transformation, each breath becomes a passage into deeper awareness, where expression transcends technique and opens into higher perception.
